description: ISO New England five-minute real-time locational marginal prices (LMP $/MWh) with their energy, congestion and loss components, for the eight New England load zones and hubs. ISO-NE runs the grid and wholesale market for CT, MA, ME, NH, RI and VT. Use for "New England power price right now", "Massachusetts wholesale electricity price", "ISO-NE zonal price spread". Requires an API key.

_apiKey.description: ISO Express credential as "username:password" or its base64. Free account at https://www.iso-ne.com/participate/applications-status-changes/.

date.description: Day to fetch as YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for the CURRENT five-minute interval; supply a date for that whole day.

location_id.description: ISO-NE location id to fetch (e.g. 4000 = .H.INTERNAL_HUB, 4004 = .Z.MASSACHUSETTS). Omit for all locations.

name: isone_lmp
